tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Supplier is permitted to supply the ordered quantity of items within 3-7 days as per the requirement of the KEA, BANGALORE.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: List of Items supplied to various Government/Quasi Government /Autonomous Institutions with Quantities during the financial years 2023-24 ,2024-25 & 2025-26 as per the Annexure-V to be enclosed along with supply orders copies of the Tenderer is to be uploaded otherwise will be considered as Non-Responsive.
PROFORMA FOR PERFORMANCE STATEMENT FOR THE LAST THREE YEARS (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)
List of items quoted by the tenderer is to be furnished/ uploaded item code wise in the E-procurement portal as per Annexure- IV otherwise will be considered as Non-Responsive.
Copy of Trade License issued by the Concerned Authority in respect of the Tenderer for Supply of stationery items is to be uploaded otherwise will be considered as Non-Responsive
Copy of valid SSI/MSI Registration Certificate: If tenderer is registered under SSI/MSI unit and copy of the same is to be uploaded otherwise will be considered as Non-Responsive
The tenderer should have supplied minimum Rs.25 Lakhs worth of Printing, Stationery & Housekeeping items in any one of last 3 financial years 2025-26, 2024-25 & 2023-24

Annual Turnover Statement For preceding last three financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 of the Tenderer certified by Chartered Accountant is to be uploaded and the average annual financial turnover for the above mentioned three shall not be less than Rs.25 Lakhs
